text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oohh! TYSM! Can't believe you<n>remembered. I feel
so seen! The<n>b-day vibes are on point!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Well, I'm giving you more<n>than just b-day
vibes today. I also<n>wanted to thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
When I'm with you, I can just chill, let<n>go, and run
free.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Let's stay the Runaway Besties<n>forever, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Omg, why you gotta make my heart<n>explode? Same
though, Runaway<n>Besties for life!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
All right! Time to go full send and run<n>from those
fiery feels of yours!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...No, you're supposed to catch thefeels, not dodge them.
